name: Vice Unbox Run
hook: Peel back the plastic wrap before publisher lawyers breach the door
tagline: A sweaty streamer frantically peels layers of bubble wrap off a bootleg Vice City game disc while legal cease-and-desist drones circle outside. Cashing out speeds away in a getaway scooter with the holy grail in hand. Crashing summons SWAT attorneys crashing through the drywall with copyright shredders.
